questions.question: Which hero of Norse mythology is known for his journey to the underworld to retrieve his deceased wife?
choices: A: Siegfried
B: Thor
C: Orpheus
D: Balder
questions.explanation: Orpheus is a central hero in Greek mythology who descended into the underworld to retrieve his wife Eurydice. This story illustrates the archetype of the hero who is willing to take great risks to save love. Similar themes exist in Norse mythology, but Orpheus is particularly known for this.
